title: Post-Generation Curation of Synthetic Images via Homogeneous-Heterogeneous Splitting
abstract: arXiv:2607.02637v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent generative models can produce high-quality synthetic images, offering scalable training training data for data-hungry models. Existing approaches to exploiting this potential typically involve 1) training or fine-tuning generators, or 2) using lightweight post-hoc adaptation like prompt engineering or inference-time guidance, making them generator-specific and expertise-intensive. We study a complementary question: given a fixed pool of generated images, can downstream utility be improved purely by selecting an informative subset? The answer is yes. translated_title: 基于同质-异质分割的合成图像生成后策展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.02637v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：近期生成模型能够产生高质量合成图像，为数据渴求型模型提供可扩展的训练数据。现有利用这一潜力的方法通常涉及1) 训练或微调生成器，或2) 使用轻量级事后适应，如提示工程或推理时引导，这使其依赖于特定生成器且需要专业知识。我们研究一个互补问题：给定固定的一组生成图像，能否仅通过选择信息丰富的子集来提高下游效用？答案是肯定的。我们表明，有效的选择必须应对现代生成器的结构性偏差：它们倾向于过度生成每个类别的典型模式，而低估类内变化。基于这一洞察，我们将每个真实类别拆分为典型的同质（HO）子集和非冗余的异质（HE）子集，然后通过保真度-多样性评分对合成图像进行筛选。
tldr: 本文提出一种生成后策展方法，通过将真实类别分为同质和异质子集，并基于保真度-多样性评分选择合成图像子集，以在不修改生成器的情况下提升下游任务效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a post-generation curation method that splits real classes into homogeneous and heterogeneous subsets and selects synthetic image subsets via fidelity-diversity scoring, improving downstream utility without modifying generators.
